# Orbitsworks

> PIN clock-in time tracking software for construction and field service job-site crews.

Orbitsworks is a workforce management SaaS for businesses with mobile or on-site teams. Supervisors use a shared tablet at the job site to clock employees in and out with a personal PIN, with a photo captured as proof. Admins get a live dashboard, hour-approval workflow, and payroll-ready Excel reports with a daily breakdown per employee and per job site.

## Key features
- PIN-based employee clock-in/clock-out with photo verification
- Works offline; clock-in events sync automatically once back online
- Live supervisor dashboard showing who is clocked in and where
- Admin approval workflow: hours must be approved before they appear in payroll reports
- Payroll-ready Excel export with daily breakdowns, per-job-site totals, and built-in formulas
- Built for construction, field service, and multi-site crews
